Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters and sort order each morning, this feature saves that setup so it's ready whenever you need it. Create a view once—filtered by assignee, status, priority, or due date—and it stays exactly as you left it, no matter how many times you switch projects or close your browser.

Each user can save up to 50 views, enough room for every project, client, or workflow you track regularly. Views aren't limited to your own screen, either: share any saved view with your team so everyone works from the same filtered list instead of recreating it individually. Shared views update automatically as underlying tasks change, keeping your whole team aligned without extra messages or manual syncing.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no additional cost, so there's nothing new to purchase or activate. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
